Bachelor of Science in Actuarial Science

requirements.label: University direct KCSE subject groups
requirements.details: Mean grade C+ and at least C+ in English or Kiswahili, Mathematics, one eligible science, and one arts, technical or humanities subject listed by the department. The science group includes Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Physical Science or Biological Sciences.

requirements.label: Department · Advanced GCE or KACE
requirements.details: The department requires three principal passes, including Mathematics and two of Physics, Chemistry, Geography, Economics, or Art and Design. It also requires a credit in English Language at KCE level or equivalent.

requirements.label: Faculty · separate A-level guidance
requirements.details: The faculty lists two principal passes, in Mathematics and one of Physics, Chemistry, Geography, Economics or Art and Design, plus an English credit. Confirm with University of Nairobi admissions which requirement applies to the intended route.

source.title: Nairobi Built Environment faculty · A-level route

requirements.label: Recognised prior qualifications and portfolio
requirements.details: Published routes include KCSE mean grade C or the specified ordinary-level qualification with an architecture diploma, relevant KNEC diplomas at Credit or higher, and relevant degrees. Depending on the prior-study route, applicants may be asked for a portfolio and interview.

source.title: Nairobi Architecture · diploma and degree routes

profiles.notes: University direct qualification and admissions requirements.

requirements.label: BAS to BArch progression
requirements.details: Nairobi BAS with at least Lower Second Class Honours can progress directly. A Pass grade may progress after at least one year of architectural work experience. The department requires a portfolio for applicants coming from another recognised institution or readmission after the permitted break.

profiles.notes: Admission to the professional second tier after a Bachelor of Architectural Studies.

requirements.label: KACE A-level or equivalent
requirements.details: Two principal passes at D or above, with one in Mathematics or Physics and one in Economics, Geography or Chemistry. Provide an English Language credit at KCE level or equivalent.

requirements.label: Direct KCSE minimums
requirements.details: KCSE mean grade C+. At least C+ in Mathematics, Physics, English or Kiswahili, and one accepted fourth subject. The department lists Geography, Accounts, Commerce, Economics, Building Construction or Drawing and Design.

requirements.label: Check accepted fourth subject and language
requirements.details: The application portal lists English in its language field and also includes Business Studies among the possible fourth subjects. Confirm the planned subject set with the university when relying on such a combination.

requirements.label: Diploma and prior degree routes
requirements.details: KCE Division II or KCSE mean C with a relevant KNEC Diploma at Credit or equivalent can be considered. The department also lists eligible recognised degrees in built environment subjects and related disciplines.

profiles.notes: University direct qualification and admissions requirements.

requirements.label: Direct KCSE aggregate
requirements.details: The School of Mathematics publishes a minimum KCSE aggregate of B for direct consideration.

requirements.label: KACE or recognised equivalent
requirements.details: Two principal passes in Mathematics and one of Physics, Chemistry, Geography or Economics.

requirements.label: Recognised diploma route
requirements.details: Applicants with KCSE mean C may present a recognised diploma at Credit or higher in Computer Studies, Statistics, or Education with Mathematics as a major, or equivalent.

profiles.notes: University direct qualification and admissions requirements.

requirements.label: GCE A-level or KACE
requirements.details: Two principal passes in Biology and Chemistry plus at least a credit in Ordinary-level Mathematics.

requirements.label: IB Diploma · three subject grades
requirements.details: The department requires grade 5 or above in Biology, Chemistry and Mathematics. The source gives subject grades and does not specify a diploma total or an HL/SL split.

requirements.label: Direct KCSE grades
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with at least C+ in Biology or Biological Sciences and C in both Chemistry and Mathematics. The university also publishes a relevant diploma route.

profiles.notes: University direct qualification and admissions requirements.

requirements.label: IB Diploma · grade 5 in the required subjects
requirements.details: The department requires at least grade 5 in Biology, Chemistry and either Physics or Mathematics. The page publishes subject grades and does not specify an overall IB score.

requirements.label: Department · A-level subject minimums
requirements.details: At least three principal passes with grades C or higher in Biology, Chemistry and either Physics or Mathematics.

requirements.label: Faculty · separate advanced-level guidance
requirements.details: A faculty overview instead lists principal passes in Biology and Chemistry with a subsidiary in Mathematics or Physics. The programme department publishes the three principal passes. Confirm the requirements for the planned cycle.

source.title: Nairobi Health Sciences faculty · BDS requirements

requirements.label: KCSE minimum subject grades
requirements.details: Mean grade C+ and grade B or higher in Biology, Chemistry, Physics or Mathematics, and English or Kiswahili.

requirements.label: Central and direct applications
requirements.details: The September intake gives the national KUCCPS route for government sponsorship and the university online application portal for self-sponsored candidates.

profiles.notes: University direct qualification and admissions requirements.

requirements.label: School-leaving and recognised prior study
requirements.details: The application lists KCSE mean C+ or equivalent, the IB Diploma, or KACE or EACE with two principal passes. An advanced-level certificate with one principal pass plus a recognised diploma is another route.

requirements.label: Diploma coursework
requirements.details: A qualifying diploma route requires at least three course units of 45 contact hours each, or 270 contact hours total as stated by the application page.

profiles.notes: University direct qualification and admissions requirements.

requirements.label: KCSE· Mathematics minimum
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with at least B− in Mathematics.

requirements.label: KACE · subject combination
requirements.details: Two principal passes in Mathematics and one of Physics, Chemistry, Geography or Economics.

profiles.notes: University direct qualification and admissions requirements.

requirements.label: KCSE and subject thresholds
requirements.details: JKUAT lists KCSE mean C+ or a Senate-recognised equivalent. Its School of Mathematics lists Mathematics C+ and English C+.

source.title: JKUAT School of Mathematics · Actuarial Science

profiles.notes: University direct qualification and admissions requirements.

requirements.label: Advanced standing by diploma
requirements.details: A relevant diploma at Credit or higher qualifies for consideration for second-year entry. JKUAT lists third-year entry for a relevant Higher National Diploma.

profiles.notes: Published transfer and advanced entry routes.

requirements.label: University direct KCSE aggregate and cluster
requirements.details: JKUAT publishes a direct-entry aggregate of B− with a minimum of C+ across the specified four-subject cluster. It lists Mathematics, Physics and other permitted subjects or groups.

profiles.notes: University direct qualification and admissions requirements.

requirements.label: Mature entry by diploma
requirements.details: A JKUAT NIT Diploma at Distinction or Credit allows third-year entry and a Pass goes to first year. JKUAT lists first-year entry for CDACC or KNEC diploma holders at Distinction or Credit.

profiles.notes: Mature entry as stated by the programme.

requirements.label: KCSE and KACE minimums
requirements.details: For the self-sponsored route, KCSE mean C+ and Mathematics C+, or two KACE principal passes in Mathematics and one of Physics, Chemistry, Geography or Economics.

requirements.label: Eligible diplomas and intakes
requirements.details: The university lists a diploma in Statistics or Computer Studies, or a Diploma in Education with a pass in Mathematics. The course page states January, May and September full-time admissions.

profiles.notes: University direct qualification and admissions requirements.

requirements.label: Foreign secondary credentials and US tests
requirements.details: International applicants are assessed under equivalent entry standards and may need official credential equation. US citizens and permanent residents submit SAT or ACT scores for review with high school GPA. The published policy gives no university-wide numeric SAT or ACT cutoff.

requirements.label: English proficiency thresholds
requirements.details: Applicants whose studies were not in English must provide proficiency evidence. USIU-Africa lists TOEFL iBT 79 or higher within two years or IELTS 6. Check language exemptions on the admissions page.

requirements.label: IB Diploma · credit after acceptance
requirements.details: The international applicant page considers the completed IB Diploma and describes credit of six trimester units for each HL result from 4 to 7 and three units per passed subsidiary-level result. The ceiling is 30 units overall for examination credits. These figures refer to credit and placement after entry.

source.title: USIU-Africa · IB Diploma and examination credit

profiles.notes: General undergraduate international admissions and post-entry credit.
